subject: Matemática
description_pt: Realizar pesquisa envolvendo variáveis categóricas e numéricas e organizar dados coletados por meio de tabelas e gráficos de colunas simples ou agrupadas, com e sem uso de tecnologias digitais.

components.description_pt: Realizar pesquisa coletando dados de variáveis categóricas ou numéricas
components.description_en: Conduct a survey collecting categorical or numerical variable data
components.cc_component_description: Generate multiple samples of categorical data of the same size to gauge the variation in estimates or predictions.

components.description_pt: Usar gráfico de barras em escala para representar conjunto de dados com várias categorias
components.description_en: Use a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories
components.cc_component_description: Use a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories

components.description_pt: Organizar dados coletados em tabelas com e sem tecnologias digitais
components.description_en: Organize collected data in tables with and without digital technologies
components.cc_component_description: Organize and represent data with up to three categories

components.description_pt: Interpretar dados exibidos em gráficos de barras e tabelas
components.description_en: Interpret data displayed in bar graphs and tables
components.cc_component_description: Interpret data with up to three categories

cc_matches.description: Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories. Solve one- and two-step "how many more" and "how many less" problems using information presented in scaled bar graphs. *For example, draw a bar graph in which each square in the bar graph might represent 5 pets.*

Organize, represent, and interpret data with up to three categories; ask and answer questions about the total number of data points, how many in each category, and how many more or less are in one category than in another.

Use data from a random sample to draw inferences about a population with an unknown characteristic of interest. Generate multiple samples (or simulated samples) of the same size to gauge the variation in estimates or predictions. *For example, estimate the mean word length in a book by randomly sampling words from the book; predict the winner of a school election based on randomly sampled survey data. Gauge how far off the estimate or prediction might be.*

prerequisites.description_pt: Classificar objetos, considerando determinado atributo (tamanho, peso, cor, forma etc.).
Classificar objetos e figuras de acordo com suas semelhanças e diferenças.
Organizar e ordenar objetos familiares ou representações por figuras, por meio de atributos, tais como cor, forma e medida.

unlocks.description_pt: Registrar as temperaturas máxima e mínima diárias, em locais do seu cotidiano, e elaborar gráficos de colunas com as variações diárias da temperatura, utilizando, inclusive, planilhas eletrônicas.
